methods_quotes.q: Analyses included data submitted to CDC as of June 2, 2014, which were stratified by age, sex, U.S. Census region, and selected target populations
Persons who tested HIV-positive but did not report a previous HIV-positive test result were categorized as new positives.
The percentages for HIV testing events are column percentages.
The denominator for the percentage for newly identified HIV-positive persons is HIV testing events.
